answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the reef until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the horizon of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The walnut of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
